{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "staff_attentiveness",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A service theme external to sentiment with interpretable categories (friendly, helpful, attentive vs not_present). Can be segmented and compared against label_pos to reveal how service themes differ by sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_taste_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated valenced categories (delicious, excellent vs mediocre, bland) forming a clear taste theme that plausibly correlates with and can be grouped against sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_freshness",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable freshness theme (fresh vs old, cold, overcooked). Distinct from taste; supports meaningful segmentation against label_pos."
    },
    {
      "name": "portion_size",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable quantity theme (generous, adequate vs small, microscopic) that can be compared across sentiment groups."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_freshness_issue",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Near-duplicate of food_freshness with essentially identical value distribution; adds no new relationship, merely restates an existing added column."
    },
    {
      "name": "portion_size_satisfaction",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Redundant with portion_size, sharing the same category vocabulary and distribution; contributes no additional interpretable dimension."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 4,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.68,
  "rationale": "The set successfully decomposes review content into distinct, interpretable theme dimensions (service attentiveness, taste, freshness, portion size), each with well-separated valenced categories that can be grouped and compared against the label_pos focus to explore how themes differ by sentiment. This directly serves the exploratory query. However, two of the six columns are near-exact duplicates of others (food_freshness_issue ≈ food_freshness; portion_size_satisfaction ≈ portion_size), inflating the column count without opening new relationships. The heavy 'not_present' skew in some columns (staff_attentiveness, portion_size) limits comparative power for the minority categories. Net: a genuinely informative EDA schema partially weakened by redundancy."
}
